session_read: A quiet pre-open session that fails calm on two narrow technicalities (KOSPI -2.56% vs a -2% bar, futures marginally negative) rather than a genuinely hot one -- but the book itself moved plenty since Thursday. Nine tickers changed hands: a four-name stop-loss cascade (CLS, TER, COHR, IREN) traces to one correlated event, the 08-18 semis rout, not four separate thesis failures -- the tight-SL discipline working as designed. Blackstone came back into the book and immediately created a real problem: it doesn't fit any existing cluster and isn't the clean diversifier it looks like, since it shares AVGO's off-balance-sheet AI-financing tail risk. The AI-capex ratio reading 83.7% instead of ~89% is that reclassification, not de-risking -- worth remembering before anyone reads it as good news. Four catalyst-driven trims on the same WSJ financing story lead the proposal list, including a clean cap-independent profit-take on AVGO.
